London war room, scoping pass (superseded by the active entry below). meta.json written and hero sourced from Wikimedia Commons (Matt Brown, CC BY 2.0, 27 Jan 2025, 4032x3024, storefront of the actual building at 22 Frith Street). The other Commons candidate, Spudgun67's 2014 shot, is 3000x4000 portrait and fails the google-discover-audit card spec outright — recorded so a later pass doesn't re-litigate it. VERIFIED in-body: hours 07:00-05:00 per the bar's own Instagram bio, against Google's listing and two write-ups that say 04:00 (the discrepancy is stated in the body rather than resolved); Polledri family ownership into the third generation; the Baird blue plaque at 22 Frith Street; the second site at Outernet opened 9 January 2025. NOT VERIFIED: the 1949 opening-day anecdote (Abbott and Costello, the coffee-drinking contest) is family testimony and is labelled as such in the body; the Angelucci blend claim comes from Faber alone. Held at draft pending: the 16:9 hero crop, near-tov-police / near-legal-counsel / chief-editor sign-off, the mandatory google-discover-audit step 9a run, and all five non-English locales. Geocode is a manual approximation for 22 Frith Street and needs a real lookup.

Completed and moved to active. (1) STRUCTURAL RULES applied retroactively — this body was drafted 2026-09-01, before the 2026-09-02 rules existed, and failed them: one 127-word paragraph (split), and only 1 image against a 645-word body needing 3. Two in-body <Figure> images added: the Baird blue plaque, and A. Angelucci at 23b Frith Street, which the body already argues about (the blend nobody can reproduce). 3 sub-headers, no paragraph over 100 words, all six locales. (2) GOOGLE-DISCOVER-AUDIT, step 9a, PASS with one caveat. Hero is 4032x3024 — clears the 1200px width and 300,000px floors, but it is 4:3, not 16:9. Google asks for as close to 16:9 as the source allows and Commons has no landscape alternative: all four Bar Italia candidates and both Baird plaque photos are portrait. Passing 4:3 rather than shipping a portrait card. shortTitle 'Two Hours A Day, It's Shut' delivers what it promises (the hours section is the piece's spine), no withheld-noun or over-promise shape, dated and attributed, byline reachable, timeliness real (the 9 Jan 2025 Outernet second site), no affiliate link so no disclosure to preserve, static page with next/image. NOTE the two in-body images are portrait sources rendered through Figure's 16:9 crop and were NOT visually verified — upload.wikimedia.org refused direct fetches this session — so a human should confirm the crops read correctly. (3) SIGN-OFFS: near-tov-police — no headline-shape repetition against the catalogue, the FOODIE-9000 quote is a consulted-persona aside in the established pattern; near-legal-counsel — every image CC-licensed with attribution and link, the Abbott and Costello opening-day story is explicitly labelled family testimony rather than asserted, the hours discrepancy is stated rather than resolved in the bar's favour; chief editor — approved. (4) Closes the open hazlitts-london-no-natural-internal-link request in content/requests.md; the reciprocal link was added to hazlitts-london/en.mdx in the same pass. Soho now has 2 board pins, which clears MIN_PLACES_FOR_LOCATION_PAGE — but Soho is disqualified on saturation per the 2026-09-02 neighborhoods directive, so no page push follows from this.
